ol: eMastered Supports Services: Service 1 / music production Category: Mastering Service Primary Use: Provides AI-powered mastering with the ability to match the sonic profile of a reference track. Why It Matters (2026): Offers granular control over "warmth," EQ, and compression while maintaining professional loudness. Notes: Created by Grammy-winning engineers for release-ready audio fidelity.
Tool: LANDR Supports Services: Service 1 / music production Category: Mastering Service Primary Use: Analyzes mixes and applies professional-grade signal chains for instant mastering. Why It Matters (2026): Acts as an all-in-one hub for mastering, samples, and distribution to major streaming services. Notes: Features style presets like "Warm," "Balanced," and "Open" for quick turnarounds.
Tool: iZotope Ozone 12 Supports Services: Service 1 / music production Category: Mastering Service Primary Use: An AI-assisted mastering suite offering bass control, stem EQ, and a high-performance maximizer.
